intent: Inspect and refactor EventRecord without changing its tabled contract or the frozen tests; keep it consistent with: Event Revision record of the append-only Telemetry Event Log: the persisted sample, its revision number (assigned by the repository, increasing per device/metric/tDevice key) and kind (RECORD for the first record of a key, REVISION for each later corrective or backfilled frame). Public String constants KIND_RECORD="RECORD", KIND_REVISION="REVISION".
